changelog:
Initial release of gists-page.

- Publish HTML/JS/CSS demos as GitHub Gists and share gists.page preview links.
- Supports single-file (recommended) and multi-file demos, with self-contained `index.html` preferred.
- Details multiple gist publishing methods: GitHub CLI (`gh`), GitHub MCP tools, REST API, and manual web UI.
- Explains gist-page URL structure for previewing gists and individual files.
- Documents GitHub Gist limitations and quirks (flat file storage, size, file name collisions, no binary files in API uploads).
- Describes gist-page preview service behavior, caching, update cadence, and troubleshooting tips.
summary: Publish HTML/JS/CSS demos as GitHub Gists and share gists.page preview links. Use when the user wants to share or preview a demo online, publish a snippet to gist, get a shareable preview link, or mentions gists.page or gist preview.
